info.name: WorldCat Entity Data Bibliographic Resources API

params.name: oclcNumber
params.description: record OCLC number

params.name: q
params.description: query in the form of a keyword search or fielded search, for example  (au:gazihan OR au:womacka) AND kw:java See - https://help.oclc.org/Librarian_Toolbox/Searching_WorldCat_Indexes/Bibliographic_records/Bibliographic_record_indexes/Bibliographic_record_index_lists

params.name: deweyNumber
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the specified dewey classification number(s). For multiple values repeat the URL parameter. (dd index)

params.name: datePublished
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to one or more dates or to a range (in index). (2000, 2000-2010, 1990,1991)

params.name: heldByGroup
params.description: Restrict to holdings held by Group Symbol

params.name: heldBy
params.description: Institution Symbol

params.name: heldBySymbol
params.description: Institution Symbol

params.name: heldByInstitutionID
params.description: Institution registryId

params.name: heldByRelevanceGroup
params.description: Filter holdings to specified relevance groups

params.name: heldByBranchID
params.description: Filter holdings to specified branch IDs

params.name: inLanguage
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified language (ln index). (eng, fre, ger)

params.name: inCatalogLanguage
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified cataloging language (ll index). (dut, eng)

params.name: materialType
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the specified material type (mt index). (URL, LPS)

params.name: catalogSource
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single OCLC symbol as the cataloging source (cs index). (OSL)

params.name: itemType
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified OCLC top-level facet type (x0 index). (book, image)

params.name: itemSubType
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to the single specified OCLC sub facet type (x1 index). (dvd, digital)

params.name: retentionCommitments
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to bibliographic records with a retention commitment (l8 index).

params.name: spProgram
params.description: Limiter to restrict the response to bibliographic records associated with a particular shared print program (l8 index).

params.name: genre
params.description: Genre to limit results to (ge index)

params.name: topic
params.description: topic to limit results to (s0 index). Based on OCLC Conspectus Division

params.name: subtopic
params.description: subtopic to limit results to (s1 index). Based on OCLC Conspectus Category

params.name: audience
params.description: Audience to limit results to

params.name: content
params.description: Content to limit results to

params.name: openAccess
params.description: filter to just open access content

params.name: peerReviewed
params.description: filter to just peer reviewed content

params.name: dbIds
params.description: The database IDs to filter to

params.name: facets
params.description: The requested list of facets requested in the response

params.name: groupRelatedEditions
params.description: Whether or not to use FRBR grouping. Default is 'false'

params.name: groupVariantRecords
params.description: Whether or not to group variant records. Default is 'false'

params.name: preferredLanguage
params.description: language user would prefer metadata description in

params.name: showLocalBibData
params.description: whether or not to show local bibliographic data in response

params.name: showHoldingsIndicators
params.description: whether or not to show holdings indicators in response

params.name: enableSearchExpansion
params.description: whether or not to expand search terms

params.name: lat
params.description: latitude

params.name: lon
params.description: longitude

params.name: distance
params.description: distance

params.name: unit
params.description: distance unit

params.name: bookReviews
params.description: Filter results to include, exclude, or only show book reviews

params.name: newsArticles
params.description: Filter results to include, exclude, or only show news articles

params.name: orderBy
params.description: result sort key

params.name: offset
params.description: start position of the bib records to return (0 based), default 0

params.name: limit
params.description: maximum number of records to return, maximum 50, default 10
